public_definitions: The goal is to review the public infrastructure grant application dashboard, compare the 2013 application volume for United States and Canada, then open the country grant intake follow-up record for the country with the larger 2013 volume.
The comparison scope is the 2013 application volume for United States and Canada as shown in the dashboard.
The rules are to use the dashboard as the evidence source and to select the country with the larger 2013 volume.
